g.text: Chef Station "Simon" ESP32 Illuminated Button Wiring
Five momentary switch inputs + five individually switched lamp outputs
+12V lamp supply rail - shared lamp positives only
COMMON GROUND RAIL: ESP32 GND + supply - + switch GND + MOSFET sources
Perfboard area: MOSFET low-side lamp drivers
MOSFET sources + pulldowns to common GND
TO-220 front pinout: Gate / Drain / Source
All grounds must be common. Do not connect lamp negatives together if individual flashing is required. Shared +V is OK; switched
low side controls each lamp. Use INPUT_PULLUP for button inputs. These uxcell buttons use 12V LEDs; observe LED polarity.
IRFB11N50APBF is overkill and not logic-level, but acceptable for small lamp loads; replace with a logic-level MOSFET if lamps
yellow/blue: switch signal to ESP32 input
green: ESP32 lamp output to MOSFET gate
orange: individual lamp negative to MOSFET drain
Switch side: one switch terminal to GND, one to GPIO. Lamp
side: LED+ to +V, LED- to MOSFET drain.
